DeployBot: Deploy starting: tag `v2.14.0-release-2026-03-20` -> prod. Kickoff: migration job `schema_stream_backfill_91234` on `db-prod-02`. Steps: add_nullable_col users.settings_v2 -> streaming_backfill -> index_swap. Estimated 15m. Runbook: https://redwood/release/runbooks/migration-stream
sarah: watching. toggling canary to 10% now.
miguel: FYI backfill uses streaming + small batch; should be lock-free but keep eye on index concurrency.
anya: oncall, expect small write amplification — will watch replication lag.
DeployBot: migration job 91234: step `add_column users.settings_v2` STARTED (pid=2271)
ryan: logged into `db-prod-02`, tailing logs:
```
2026-03-20T16:02:05Z INFO backfill: started shard 0/12
2026-03-20T16:02:09Z INFO backfill: processed 30k rows
```
DeployBot: migration job 91234: step `streaming_backfill` PROGRESS 30% (processed 360k/1.2M)
oncall-bot: latency alert: p95 API latency ↑ 180ms -> 310ms in us-east-1 (10:16:30)
elaine: pulling canary back to 5%, moving more traffic to dedicated canary host.
sarah: agree. pause expansion.

DeployBot: migration job 91234: step `streaming_backfill` RETRY on shard 7 (timeout), requeued chunk -> started
miguel: shard 7 has large tenant X — recommend running per-tenant short-run: `backfill --tenant X --limit 100k`
anya: see replication lag spike on replica-03 (lag 24s) — lowering workers to 4
DeployBot: migration job 91234: workers adjusted to 4

DeployBot: migration job 91234: step `streaming_backfill` COMPLETE (processed 1.2M rows) duration 22m. No schema lock taken.
ryan: running final index swap: `ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN settings -> settings_v1; ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN settings_v2 -> settings`
DeployBot: migration job 91234: step `index_swap` STARTED
DeployBot: migration job 91234: step `index_swap` FAILED on node db-prod-02 (constraint violation: duplicate key on users.email) — automatic rollback initiated for index_swap
elaine: hmm, we've seen dup email once in tenant X pre-migration. Can we run dedupe script then retry?
miguel: propose aborting swap on prod, fallback to previous index, and cut release window. We should pin traffic to v2.13.4 tag while we fix. Thoughts?
sarah: +1 pin. We can't risk broken index. Rollback release and hold.

DeployBot: Initiating rollback of index_swap, restoring previous index state. Estimated wait ~5m.
DeployBot: index_swap rollback COMPLETE. Migration job 91234 overall status: PARTIAL_SUCCESS (backfill done, index_swap rolled back).
anya: I'll open a follow-up ticket with stack trace and tenant IDs: https://redwood/issues/INF-2314
ryan: noted. create release note entry: "Migration streaming backfill completed for v2.14.0 but index swap failed due to data anomaly; release pinned to v2.13.4 until remediation."
elaine: scheduling change window and remed plan: dedupe + small patch for uniqueness check — aiming patch in next canary on Mon 03/22.

DeployBot: Deploy aborted to stable tag `v2.13.4`. All canaries rolled back. Final status: ROLLED_BACK (reason: index_swap constraint failure).
